system.longDesc: You can treat certain conditions in the field. See Conditions in Chapter 1 for details.

degree0.desc: Your treatment allows a patient to add your Intelligence (and Medicine focus, if any) to a test to avoid or overcome a medical hazard, or it grants the patient a new test to overcome that hazard, if there is one. This includes saving a patient from dying and reviving an unconscious character.

degree1.desc: If you treat a patient, you can alleviate the effects of the Exhausted, Fatigued, Injured, and Wounded conditions. This takes an advanced TN 11 Intelligence (Medicine) test (threshold 5) with each roll taking one minute. If you succeed, the patient ignores the effects of all these conditions for 1d6 hours, even if they have more than one of them. The conditions are still present, however, and the effects return when the 1d6 hours you rolled are up. Furthermore, If the patient takes one of these conditions while under the effects of your treatment or they gain a new degree of Fatigued, the period of alleviation stops immediately, though you can treat the patient again.

degree2.desc: You can quickly treat wounds to prevent them from becoming serious. If you treat a wounded condition within an hour of it occurring, you can make a basic TN 13 Intelligence (Medicine) test. Success downgrades the wounded condition to injured.
